title: Vintage Early American Pattern Glass Lace Drapery Creamer
descriptionText:
Early American Pattern Glass - produced from around 1850 - 1914, placing this piece within that time frame. Developed to provide a less expensive alternative to hand -cut crystal that would be affordable to the masses, it was immediately popular.

The Drapery Glass pattern has a scalloped rim with a decorative pattern resembling lace or drapery.
